objective: Same declared domains, target weights, epsilon and unit costs; minimize reviews with exact width guarantees
timing: Median of three alternating-order measurements; include pricing and proof construction

dense.factorial: all four target-count / epsilon pairs at each size, four repetitions
dense.weights: independent integer weights 1..12, normalized per target

regression.scope: Previously observed cases are regression only

gates: Every feasible set independently checked with original rational constraints
Tiny-case exhaustive oracle checks every claimed minimum and lower bound
Every lower-bound certificate verified independently of pricing and search
Pricing floats are guidance only; validity derives from exact nonnegative rational prices
Public experimental inputs are identified by normalized source hashes
Freeze implementation before first held-out run; report all cases and regressions
limits: Guided heuristics under equal node budgets can still lose to V1 search; report such cases
Shared-resource accounting and hinge duality are established mathematical ideas; analogy does not prove novelty
No human labels, domain calibration or population accuracy claims
Local frozen split, not external preregistration; all pricing overhead included in timings
